name: Heavy oil upgrading (in-field)
principle: Upgrading is done near or in the reservoir to cut viscosity before transport. THAI's in-situ combustion upgraded oil by 3 to 7 API points at Kerrobert, and a nanocatalyst pilot in Colombia raised API from 11.6° to 13.4° while viscosity fell from 39,987 cP to 11,734 cP.

process_steps.name: Heat or catalyse heavy oil in place

source.note: In Situ Combustion Ltd, Toe-to-Heel Air Injection (THAI) brochure (field results to March 2022)
Wikipedia, Heavy crude oil, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

advantages: Smaller diluent needs and easier transport
limitations: Few pilots; Wikipedia's heavy crude page does not cover upgrading
